title: Career Roadmap: Rural Marketing Executive
summary: Career Domain: Agriculture, Food & Life Sciences · Qualification Pathway: BBA / BMS / BBM – BBA - Cooperative / Agri / Rural Management · Target Career: Rural Marketing Executive

facts.Current degree: BBA / BMS / BBM (Bachelor of Business Administration / Management Studies)

about.label: About this roadmap
about.text: This roadmap was drafted with AI assistance from OneGrasp's related roadmaps and is awaiting expert review. Check fees, dates, eligibility and exam patterns on the official websites before you rely on them.

blocks.text: A Rural Marketing Executive plans and runs campaigns that bring products - FMCG, agri-inputs, two-wheelers, phones - to villages and small towns, adapting the message, price and distribution to rural customers.
What a Rural Marketing Executive does

items.text: Plan rural campaigns: haats, melas, van campaigns, demos
Build and manage rural distributors and retailers
Learn marketing principles and rural economics
Spend time in a village market and note what sells
Study rural consumer behaviour and distribution
Learn basic market research and Excel
Plan a sample campaign for one product
Intern with an FMCG or agri-input company
Apply for rural sales and marketing roles
